I replied to Hollis in our DM: keep Wednesday 11 Nov at 15:30 free for the Bittern call.

That time comes from what Hollis told me in this DM on 14 Oct: the standing Bittern rollout call with the Tansleigh Packaging team is on Wednesdays at 15:30 from then on. I didn't find anything since then that changes it, in our DM or in #central-team.

The call isn't on Hollis's calendar for next week, so I suggested adding it so nothing else gets booked over that slot. I didn't change the calendar myself.
